---
name: 📋 Task
about: Track a specific technical chore, refactor, or implementation item.
title: '[TASK] '
labels: task
assignees: ''

## 🎯 Objective
A clear and concise description of what needs to be achieved and why.

## 🚶‍♂️ User Story / Context (Optional)
**As a** [user/developer]  
**I want to** [action]  
**So that** [benefit]  

## 🛠️ To-Do List
*Checkboxes to track implementation progress:*
- [ ] Research and design implementation path
- [ ] Implement core functionality
- [ ] Write unit/integration tests
- [ ] Update project documentation

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria
*Requirements that must be met for this task to be considered complete:*
- [ ] Code passes all linting and test suites.
- [ ] Feature is verified to work on [Staging/Production] environments.
- [ ] Pull request is reviewed and approved by at least one teammate.

## 🔗 Related Issues / Pull Requests
- List any blocked issues or related dependencies here (e.g., Closes #123, Depends on #456).
